title: Parity function
statement: For a finite set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the parity function on sign vectors $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ is $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$, with values in the signs $\{-1,1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite subset $S$ of the $n$ coordinate indices
